purpose: Verified contract for constructing date-aware timelines of party/property-interest relationships.
relationship_rule: Each timeline relationship is independently supported and linked to a defined party, property interest and temporal scope.
date_rule: Relationship dates are not silently substituted with document or registration dates.
causation_rule: A relationship change may be linked to an event only where the causal link is supported.
historical_rule: Historical roles require evidence appropriate to the target period.
privacy_rule: Public relationship timelines expose only approved, necessary relationship information.
verification_boundary: The timeline organizes verified relationships and transitions; it does not create unsupported legal relationships.
